why: Section 1g: the level changes HOW the coach explains. A nervous beginner three weeks in asks an advanced question she read online. The good answer is the short true answer in everyday words and the one thing that matters more for her now (turning up, adding a little each week); the failure is a lecture in jargon (periodisation, hypertrophy, mesocycle, RPE scales) or a list of techniques. Graded mostly by the judge (voice, teaches, warm); the code check holds only that it stays a conversation (no card).
